mapper.sql: id, apply_id, request_id, provider_code, profile_id, mobile_no, profile_version_id, (SELECT up.partner_user_id FROM user_profile up WHERE up.id = profile_id) AS partner_user_id, external_credit_apply_no, status, external_status, freeze_end_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM credit_application WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO credit_application ( apply_id, request_id, provider_code, profile_id, mobile_no, profile_version_id, status, submitted_at ) VALUES ( #{applyId}, #{requestId}, #{providerCode}, #{profileId}, #{mobileNo}, #{profileVersionId}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) )
mapper.update: UPDATE credit_application SET status = #{status}, external_status = #{externalStatus}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, finalized_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'FAILED', 'CANCEL') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE finalized_at END WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE credit_application SET status = CASE WHEN status IN ('INIT', 'SUBMITTING') THEN 'PROCESSING' ELSE status END, external_credit_apply_no = #{externalCreditApplyNo}, external_status = #{externalStatus}, submitted_at = COALESCE(submitted_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM credit_application WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND next_poll_at IS NOT NULL AND next_poll_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY next_poll_at LIMIT #{limit}
